humanHealth.rationale: Keep continuous, source-native annual health loss. Each middle two-point step represents ten times the lost healthy years. Fixed absolute amounts compare aggregate health loss, rather than rarity, exposure, catalogue rank or the severity of an individual case.
humanHealth.outerReference: WHO GHE global all-cause DALYs in 2021; frozen for this method version, not refitted to a newer catalogue or annual total.
humanHealth.zeroRule: Verified zero for the declared health endpoint only; no data is not zero.
humanHealth.admittedScope: An annual attributable DALY endpoint with a matched geography, source model, counterfactual and causal boundary. This selection does not establish coverage of all human consequences.
notEstablished: The four middle thresholds are TULIP policy choices, not WHO thresholds or scientifically determined equivalences.
A health-only endpoint does not supply services, livelihoods or a complete human component where those outcomes are material.
Independent scientific review and empirical validation of a complete replacement node are not completed by selecting these benchmarks.

nature.rationale: Identical loss of comparable ecological condition over the same physical area receives the same contribution. Smaller ecosystem families do not silently receive a larger per-area weight.
nature.withinTypeRule: Use a fixed, reviewed outcome profile with reference conditions, terminal characteristics and documented overlap. Keep composition, structure, function and connectivity visible. One cover percentage cannot silently represent the whole profile.
nature.unknownRule: Unmeasured material characteristics or ecosystem families are unknown, not zero; no denominator or weight renormalization.
nature.stockRule: Current condition stock is not multiplied by observation history or assumed future recovery years.
remainingCalibration: A supported common interpretation and trade-off rule across ecological characteristics, including species and functional losses.
A harmonized exclusive spatial reference, or explicit allocation for overlapping assets, that covers the intended nature scope.
Fixed numerical consequence amounts for 3, 5, 7 and 9 tested on compatible external outcome cases. The two-family synthetic fractions are not admissible evidence.

nonHealthHuman.serviceRule: Where a supported model estimates health effects of a service loss, enter those effects once in the health endpoint. Keep residual non-health wellbeing effects separate until an explicit, supported equivalence and overlap rule exists.
nonHealthHuman.displacementRule: Do not equate movements with unique harmed people or the displaced stock. Do not treat IDMC wellbeing life-years as DALYs. Its worked-example parameter ambiguity remains unresolved.

scoreLanguage.rule: The score describes aggregate harm on a nonlinear policy scale. A low total may contain severe individual outcomes. A high total need not imply that every affected person or ecosystem has permanent harm.
